name: Commerce CIB
description: Off-site Drupal Commerce payment gateway for the Hungarian CIB bank, using DES-encrypted SAKI messaging with server-side confirmation and refunds.
project_description:
Commerce CIB provides a Drupal Commerce payment method through the gateway of the CIB Bank .

 This module complies to the following requirements of the CIB Bank:

 
 Sends out an email to the customer with the transaction details in case of both successful and failed transactions. 
 Handles transaction timeouts correctly. 
 
 It does not deal with displaying neither the required bank and bank card logos nor the banking and payment information links. 

 Install 
 D7 
 The D7 module does not work from php 7.2 upwards due to [#3154815].

 
 Enable the commerce_cib module 
 At /admin/commerce/config/payment-methods edit the CIB bank payment method. Click edit next to the "CIB bank" action. Fill out the form. 
 Enable the commerce_cib_rules module to get example rules. At /admin/config/workflow/rules edit (or if you want to export them, clone and edit) the CIB rules to your liking. 
 
 D8 
 
 Enable the commerce_cib module 
 Add a CIB payment gateway at admin/commerce/config/payment-gateways.
